title: Processing a returned cheque

steps.title: Check the amount and the return reason
Reverse the full credit from the customer's account
Tick off the checklist and complete the return

decisions: If the return is technical (e.g. missing endorsement or stale date), re-present the cheque once with no fee; if it is insufficient funds or a stopped cheque, reverse the credit and charge the returned-cheque fee.
Waive the fee only with the supervisor's approval and only for a first return in twelve months; this customer had a return in June, so no waiver.
warnings: Always reverse the full amount, even if it takes the customer overdrawn; never part-reverse, because a partial reversal leaves a break for Treasury.
openQuestions: Whether returns arriving after the 15:00 cut-off go into today's or tomorrow's batch: Margot will confirm with the clearing house liaison.
